experiments.scope: H1, H1-P1, H3-P1, H5' and the algorithm (proof.md Sections 2-5). Trials 0..7: a first block drawn from SHAKE-256 of the seed, its real 38-step chaining value, and the counted procedure of proof.md Section 3 at a reduced table of 2^16 slots with 2^12 distinct scan words u0 + n (full scale: 2^26 slots, 2^28 words): table build, scan, post-filters C1, C2, G, F7, and step 3b on every good pair. Every claw is checked three ways: against an independent sorted-array search over the same table and words (claws_equal_ref), by rebuilding the real E16 of member x (claw_e16_in_S160), and by evaluating the post-filters on the real words of both members (postfilter_ref_mismatch). A pair is returned only if step 3b accepts it (rows 16..21 pass and A34..A37, E34..E37 are equal); none is expected at this size. Trial 8 runs step 3b on the P8 pair itself (accepts, 3,014 operations). Trials 9..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 (none expected at the reduced size; any returned pair is a full collision). On every working trial: claws_equal_ref = 1, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Reproducible observations: occ_frac (about 0.632), claws against expected_claws, the stage counts c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, good_pairs (each runs step 3b), step3b_collisions and counted_ops. A local emulation of the 256-trial request took 8.2 s on a loaded host (load 28 on 24 threads).

experiments.scope: H2-P1 and H3-P1 (proof.md Sections 7-9). Trials 0..7: a seed-drawn chaining value, the claws of the procedure at 2^16 slots with 2^13 distinct scan words; for every claw both members are rebuilt and the tests of rows 16..21 of step 3b are applied in order, reporting how many claws pass rows 16, 17, ..., 21 cumulatively, the post-filter stage counts, and the number of distinct pairs (a0, a1) among the claws of the chaining value. Trial 8 runs step 3b on the P8 pair. No pair is returned by design: the acceptance probability of a good pair is about 2^-71.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. distinct_pairs = claws and rows_le16 = row16_passes = claws on every working trial (every claw is a row-16 pass of member x and the row-16 tests of both members are functions of E16x); rows_le17 and beyond are 0 at this size because a claw reaches row 17 only as a good pair. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1. A local emulation took 4.8 s on the same loaded host.
